best_idea: A body that vanishes spills its whole inventory to the ground at its tile, a body that stays keeps its loot for a looter, and on zone re-entry after a long gap the remaining dead bodies spill and are removed unless flagged no-drop.
decision_why: Take the spill-on-vanish rule and the no-drop flag, but the vanish must be a server state set at the kill, not an animation id; the zone re-entry expiry belongs to zones-as-data and overlaps row 23 despawn.
acceptance: A server test kills an enemy with a vanishing attack and asserts its inventory appears as ground piles at its tile; a normal kill leaves the inventory on the corpse; a no-drop archetype leaves nothing on the ground; a zone re-entry after the threshold turns remaining corpses into ground piles and removes them.
